q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an e-rickshaw?
title: E-rickshaw carbon footprint per vehicle
short: Weigh the steel chassis and body, add the motor, controller, wiring and tyres, and multiply each by supplier figures. Add welding, painting and assembly energy, divide by vehicles built and count the battery pack as its own line.

ul: Steel tubes and sheet for chassis and body.
Hub motor, controller and wiring harness.

p: Report per vehicle with and without the battery, and name the battery chemistry, since lead acid and lithium packs differ a lot.

example.title: Worked example: e-rickshaw unit per vehicle (one month)
lines: Plant total: 16,584 / 400 = 41.5 kg CO2 per vehicle
Add steel, motor, battery and tyres for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
